extras: Works on desktop and mobile; supports both legacy and new tree-item file explorer DOM.
intentEvidence: Click an already-active file in Obsidian's file explorer to rename it inline.
problem: Users must rely on context menus or keyboard shortcuts to rename files in the file explorer.
summary: Ara allows users to rename files directly within the Obsidian file explorer by clicking an active file twice, mimicking Windows File Explorer behavior.
